governance_preregistration_note: Pre-registered candidate protocol authorized under GOVERNANCE.md before human data collection to prevent post-hoc threshold fitting. Canonical CPE45.json retains success_thresholds=null, physiological_validation='not_done', and historical_experiments_cpe45_status='not_assessed' until ratified via DEC after MEASUREMENT-3 human data.
anti_fitting_statement: Thresholds are pre-registered from external physiology/occupational standards or explicitly labeled as unvalidated cross-domain priors/hypotheses requiring SEM/MDC_95 calibration in MEASUREMENT-3A — never fitted to EXP-0139..0157 cohorts.

intensity_schedule.structure: 5 identical 540-s macro-blocks partitioning [0, 2700] s without gaps or overlaps

effort.prescription: Maximal all-out explosive bout (1:4 work:rest matches fast PCr resynthesis half-time ~21-30 s; Glaister 2005 SRC-0031, Girard 2011 SRC-0029)

Heavy-domain sustained effort prescribed at 80-90% individual Critical Power (CP) — strictly below the heavy-to-severe boundary (100% CP; Burnley & Jones 2018, Jones et al. 2019) so superimposed 15x6-s all-out sprints do not exhaust W' prematurely before 2700 s.

post45_observation_times_s.mandatory_timestamp_rule: Exact individual elapsed timestamp t > 2700 s must fall inside its declared window; nominal labels without timestamps or out-of-window timestamps are rejected.

statistical_rule.method: Intersection-Union Test (IUT, Berger 1982) via participant-clustered bootstrap CI
statistical_rule.fwer_guarantee: Testing H0 (any channel fails) vs H1 (all k channels pass) controls FWER <= alpha without Bonferroni adjustment when each one-sided CI uses level 1-alpha (two-sided 95% CI is conservative with FWER <= 0.025).
statistical_rule.joint_power_requirement: For k=10 mandatory channels at dz=0.65, N=24 yields only 49-68% joint IUT power (29-52% at two-sided 95% CI); confirmatory joint-PASS requires N>=40 completers (82-88% two-sided / 92-94% one-sided joint power).

absolute_demand_floor.external_basis: 80% CP in trained adults (CP ~3.0-4.0 W/kg) across D=0.6444 yields ~5.0-7.0 kJ/kg; 5.0 kJ/kg floor prevents low-output pacing gaming without excluding healthy adults with CP ~2.8-3.0 W/kg. Absolute J and W are always reported alongside kJ/kg.

mechanical_retention_late_vs_early.external_basis: Mechanistically motivated priors from short RSA (Girard 2011 SRC-0029), endurance durability (Maunder 2021), and barbell velocity loss (Sanchez-Medina 2011) — explicitly NOT validated 2700-s norms until MEASUREMENT-3A.

spatial_motor_control_meters.external_basis: Scaled to adult minimum foot clearance literature (~10-20 mm; Begg 2007, Barrett 2010, DUO-GAIT SRC-0195), NOT a validated 2700-s standard; MEASUREMENT-3A familiarization visits must verify threshold >= MDC_95 (1.96*sqrt(2)*SEM).

concurrent_cognitive_control.joint_evaluation_rule: Evaluated independently by cognitive Trial.task_id across early [0,540) and late [2160,2700] windows; correct-trial RT ALWAYS coupled with accuracy and omissions.

thermoregulatory_limits.separation_rule: Research efficacy ceiling (PASS/FAIL) is strictly separated from IRB medical stop rule (immediate termination at >=39.5 C or >=39.0 C with symptoms/unacclimatized status).
thermoregulatory_limits.external_basis: ISO 9886:2004 (38.0 C unmonitored / 38.5 C monitored safe operating limit / 39.0 C upper limit only for medically monitored acclimatized individuals), NIOSH 2016, and IOC Heat Consensus (Racinais et al. 2023 PMC9811094).

stage_3a_calibration_and_reliability.purpose: Estimate within-task SEM and MDC_95 on familiarization visits, measure inter-channel covariance matrix, calibrate empirical norms (temperate 20 C / 50% RH vs Joule-matched continuous control), and ratify canonical CPE45.json via DEC.
stage_3a_calibration_and_reliability.power_note: Provides 92.4% single-channel power (one-sided alpha=0.05, dz=0.65) and +-0.42 SD CI precision; NOT powered for simultaneous 10-channel confirmatory PASS.

stage_3b_confirmatory_joint_pass.purpose: Confirmatory joint IUT evaluation of a candidate biological system across all mandatory CPE45 + post45 channels simultaneously.
stage_3b_confirmatory_joint_pass.power_note: Monte Carlo verified (k=10, dz=0.65): 91.7-94.1% joint power (one-sided alpha=0.05) and 81.5-88.1% joint power even under conservative two-sided 95% CIs across rho=0.0..0.5.
